description: This file defines a set of simple methods for sales opportunity and forecast management in an OFBiz-based application, including creation, update, and role management functionalities.

methods.name: createSalesForecast
methods.description: Creates a new sales forecast record, stores it, and saves a history copy.

methods.name: updateSalesForecast
methods.description: Updates an existing sales forecast record and saves its history.

methods.name: saveSalesForecastHistory
methods.description: Saves a copy of the sales forecast into history for auditing or tracking.

methods.name: updateSalesOpportunity
methods.description: Updates a sales opportunity, setting estimated close date if stage is closed.

methods.name: createSalesOpportunityAccountRole
methods.description: Creates a role entry linking a sales opportunity to an account party if not already associated.

methods.name: createSalesOpportunityLeadRole
methods.description: Creates a role entry linking a sales opportunity to a lead party.

methods.name: findPartyInSalesOpportunityRole
methods.description: Finds and retrieves the party ID associated with a specific role in a sales opportunity.
